facts.fact: The SudaPass terms of use (published 2026-05-21; the date is used as the as_of since the terms carry no other date) treat the Electronic Transactions Act of 2007 and its amendments as the governing law, stating that a digital signature meeting its requirements is equivalent to a handwritten signature (Article 8) and that forgery is punishable under Article 28.

systems.owner: National Electronic Authentication Authority (National Authority for Digital Certification)
systems.tiers: government and commercial services; three trust levels
